facts.en: Completed a hospitality services certificate at Fictional Coastpetal College in 2021.
facts.zh: 2021 年在虚构海瓣学院完成酒店接待服务证书课程。

facts.en: Paid seasonal equipment-hire assistant at Fictional Shellpath Beach Lodge during 2023-05 to 2023-09, 2024-05 to 2024-09 and 2025-05 to 2025-09.
facts.zh: 在虚构贝径海滩旅舍任有薪季节性用品租赁助理，任职期间为 2023-05 至 2023-09、2024-05 至 2024-09 及 2025-05 至 2025-09。

facts.en: Issued deck chairs, beach mats and shade umbrellas against numbered hire slips.
facts.zh: 依据编号租赁单发放躺椅、沙滩垫及遮阳伞。

facts.en: Recorded collection and return times and checked item tags against the hire slip.
facts.zh: 记录领取及归还时间，并依据租赁单核对物品标签。

facts.en: Set aside visibly damaged returned items for the lodge supervisor rather than placing them back in the hire rack.
facts.zh: 将归还时可见损坏的物品留给旅舍主管，而非放回租赁架。

facts.en: Followed the lodge’s approved issue restrictions and relayed supervisor-confirmed closures to guests.
facts.zh: 遵循旅舍获批的发放限制，并向宾客转达主管确认的暂停开放信息。

facts.en: The role covered shore-based guest equipment, not boats, rescue services or lifeguard duties.
facts.zh: 该岗位涵盖岸上宾客用品，不涉及船艇、救援服务或救生员职责。

facts.en: Logged cash and card receipts in the hire till and passed deposit-refund decisions to the supervisor.
facts.zh: 在租赁收银记录中登记现金及刷卡收款，并将押金退款决定交给主管。

facts.en: A 2025-08 closing sheet lists 54 item loans and 49 returns during one shift; 5 loans were still within their agreed return times.
facts.zh: 2025-08 的一份交班表列明单个班次借出 54 件物品、归还 49 件；5 件借出物品仍在约定归还时间内。

facts.en: The closing sheet does not describe those 5 items as lost or overdue.
facts.zh: 该交班表未将这 5 件物品描述为遗失或逾期。

facts.en: Uses numbered receipt books, a till interface and a daily stock-count sheet.
facts.zh: 使用编号收据簿、收银界面及每日库存盘点表。

facts.en: Helped arrange a clearer item-tag rack in 2024-06; the supervisor approved the final layout.
facts.zh: 2024-06 协助布置更清晰的物品标签架；最终布局由主管批准。

facts.en: Explained hire periods in English and used approved translated phrase cards when needed.
facts.zh: 使用英语解释租赁时段，并在需要时使用获批译文短语卡。

facts.en: The record does not identify the languages on all phrase cards or an independently tested second-language level.
facts.zh: 记录未指明所有短语卡的语言，亦未记录经独立测试的第二语言水平。

facts.en: No off-season employment at the lodge is recorded.
facts.zh: 未记录在该旅舍淡季任职的经历。

facts.en: Volunteered at Fictional Shoreglass Litter Group during 2022-04 to 2025-10 on occasional weekend cleanups.
facts.zh: 2022-04 至 2025-10 在虚构岸玻璃清洁团体偶尔参加周末清理志愿活动。

facts.en: Prepared glove and bag issue lists for 6 cleanup sessions; the organizer selected sites and supervised activities.
facts.zh: 为 6 场清理活动准备手套及垃圾袋发放清单；地点选择及活动监督由组织者负责。

facts.en: Joined an amateur sand-sculpture display in 2024 as part of a 3-person group; no award is recorded.
facts.zh: 2024 年作为 3 人小组的一员参加业余沙雕展示；未记录获奖。

facts.en: Keeps a personal collection of original seaside sketch postcards.
facts.zh: 保留个人原创海滨素描明信片集。

facts.en: Availability for the vacancy’s next full season has not been stated.
facts.zh: 尚未说明是否可在该岗位下一整个旺季工作。
